_note: One entry per file in slides/. `alt` is what a screen reader gets — the slides are pictures of text, so each needs a real one-sentence description. `draft: true` means Claude wrote it and Aidan has not checked it yet; set it to false once you have. A file with no entry here shows a visible bracketed placeholder on the page.
_source: Rendered from docs/tailor-studio-design.pdf in the tailor-studio repo with `swift scripts/pdf-to-slides.swift <pdf> public/tailor-studio/slides`.

01.png.alt: Title slide: Tailor Studio, a personal resale tool for Grailed.

02.png.alt: The problem: fifteen to twenty minutes of manual work per listing.

03.png.alt: What it is: Tailor groups, writes and prices listings, and the sale stays with a person.

04.png.alt: The workflow: five stages from a photo folder to a published listing.

05.png.alt: Stage one, Import: photos grouped by garment, with details read from the images.

06.png.alt: Stage two, Draft: a written listing with a price range from sold comparables.

07.png.alt: Stage three, Review: one card per draft, keyboard-first.

08.png.alt: Stage four, Fill: one click types the draft into the Grailed sell form.

09.png.alt: Stage five, Publish: you click Publish yourself.

10.png.alt: Safety rails: what Tailor does, and what it never does.

11.png.alt: Built for speed: the keyboard shortcuts.

12.png.alt: Get started: three steps to a first listing.
